description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key fields from enterprise business licenses, including the Unified Social Credit Code, company name, address, entity type, legal representative, registered capital, organizational form, incorporation date, business term, and business scope. It supports business licenses, private non-enterprise registration certificates, social organization legal person registration certificates, and public institution legal person certificates
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别企业营业执照中的统一社会信用代码、公司名称、地址、主体类型、法定代表人、注册资金、组成形式、成立日期、营业期限和经营范围等关键有效字段。支持营业执照、民办非企业登记证书、社会团体法人登记证书、事业单位法人证书
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-business-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1nnHJNSrqK1RjSZK9XXXyypXa-564-829.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeBusinessLicense

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one, and neither can be empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
